description: Engineering change filter. Any new engineering request must be classified. Only the first 6 categories may enter the controlled pilot change queue automatically. Everything else requires management review.

classification_categories.description: a fix required to keep the pilot running (e.g., a control that fails mid-pilot)
a change required by counsel (e.g., structural change to satisfy legal opinion)
a change required by security review (e.g., pilot-blocking control gap)
a change required by the bank for pilot participation (e.g., pilot-blocking requirement)
a change required by the regulator (e.g., to satisfy authorization conditions)
a requirement justified by independently measured evidence that generalizes beyond one bank/corridor
a request specific to one bank (not generalizable); requires management review
an optional enhancement; requires management review; low priority
a request without external evidence or justification; rejected by default
